source_note: Compiled from official notices and mainstream reporting. Every card links to its original source.

items.title: US cancels 6,000 visas in crackdown against birth tourism
items.summary: The United States has cancelled 6,000 visas as part of a crackdown on birth tourism. The measure targets individuals suspected of travelling to the US primarily to give birth and secure citizenship for their children.

items.title: Ireland extends visa waiver programme for Indians
items.summary: Ireland has extended its visa waiver programme that benefits Indian travellers. The programme allows eligible Indians to visit Ireland under certain conditions, making travel more accessible for those holding specific visa types.

items.title: Canada freezes intake cap for international students till 2029
items.summary: Canada has announced it will freeze the intake cap for international students until 2029 as part of its new immigration plan. This measure will limit the number of new international students who can study in Canada over the coming years.

items.title: Stricter regulations proposed for H-1B visa extensions in the US
items.summary: The United States is reportedly considering stricter regulations for H-1B visa extensions. The proposed changes could make it more difficult for H-1B visa holders to extend their work authorization, though the regulations have not yet been confirmed.

items.title: Canada visa processing times updated, visitor and super visa waits increase
items.summary: Canada has updated its visa processing times, with longer waits now reported for visitor visas and super visas for Indian applicants. The increased processing times may affect travel plans for those applying for temporary residence or family visits.

items.title: Why is it getting harder for Indians to work and settle in America?
items.summary: Recent developments including IBM's H-1B moves and tech layoffs are making it increasingly difficult for Indians to work and settle in the United States. The article examines the challenges facing Indian professionals seeking employment and permanent residence in America.

items.title: Ireland extends UK visa-linked travel waiver ahead of Christmas
items.summary: Ireland has extended its UK visa-linked travel waiver programme ahead of the Christmas season. The waiver allows certain Indian nationals holding valid UK visas to travel to Ireland without requiring a separate Irish visa.

items.title: Ireland extends UK visa waiver for Indians until December 2026
items.summary: Ireland has extended its UK visa waiver scheme for Indian travellers until December 2026. The programme allows eligible Indians with valid UK visas to enter Ireland without obtaining a separate Irish visa, subject to specific eligibility and travel rules.

items.title: US, UK lose international students as visa curbs bite
items.summary: International student enrolments have fallen significantly in the UK and US due to tightened visa restrictions, with Britain seeing a 19 per cent drop and America a 13 per cent decline. Asian countries are reportedly gaining students as a result.

items.title: Canada caps new international student arrivals at 1.5 lakh annually
items.summary: Canada's Immigration Plan for 2027 to 2029 sets an annual cap of 1.5 lakh new international student arrivals. This limit will restrict the number of foreign students who can begin their studies in Canada each year during this period.

items.title: Proposed Australian student visa rules may impact Indian applicants most
items.summary: Australia is reportedly considering new student visa rules that could affect Indian applicants more severely than students from other countries. The specific changes have not been confirmed but are expected to create additional challenges for Indian students seeking to study in Australia.

items.title: Indians face new immigration challenge beyond securing US job offers
items.summary: Indian professionals are reportedly encountering a fresh immigration hurdle in the United States that goes beyond simply obtaining a job offer. The nature of this new challenge suggests additional barriers in the US immigration process for Indian workers seeking employment-based visas.

items.title: New Zealand moves visitor visa applications online
items.summary: New Zealand has changed its visitor visa process by moving applications online. The change affects Indian tourists and business visitors applying for New Zealand visitor visas. The new system replaces the previous application method.

items.title: Indian MBA aspirants rethink overseas plans due to costs and visa restrictions
items.summary: Indian students planning MBA programmes abroad are reconsidering their options as rising costs and tighter visa restrictions create new challenges. The combination of financial pressure and stricter immigration controls is prompting applicants to reassess their study abroad plans.

items.title: New Zealand introduces online visitor visa changes for 2026
items.summary: New Zealand has announced changes to its visitor visa system for 2026, introducing new online application rules. The modifications aim to update the process for those seeking to visit New Zealand temporarily.

items.title: UK Visa Rules 2027: What Indian Students and Job Seekers Need to Know
items.summary: New visa regulations are coming to the UK in 2027 that will affect Indian students and those seeking employment. The changes will impact application requirements and processes for both categories of applicants.

items.title: UK Student Visa: The Money Rule Changes on November 30
items.summary: Financial requirements for UK student visas are changing on November 30. Students applying for UK study visas need to be aware of the updated money rules that will take effect from this date.

items.title: Dubai changes visa rules in 2026, expands visa-on-arrival and property visa criteria
items.summary: Dubai has updated its visa regulations for 2026, expanding visa-on-arrival eligibility to more nationalities and relaxing the criteria for obtaining visas through property investment in the emirate.

items.title: Canada makes rural immigration programme permanent, sets aside 5,500 admission spaces
items.summary: Canada has made its rural immigration programme a permanent pathway with 5,500 admission spaces allocated. This provides a dedicated route for those willing to settle in rural and northern communities across Canada.

items.title: Canada Doubles Low-Wage Foreign Work Permit Duration From 1 to 2 Years
items.summary: Canada has extended the validity period for low-wage foreign worker permits from one year to two years. This change doubles the duration that eligible workers can remain employed in Canada under this category.

items.title: US visa for AI professionals: Why your job title may not match your H-1B eligibility
items.summary: AI professionals applying for US H-1B visas may face eligibility issues based on job titles. The article explains why the job title alone may not accurately reflect whether an AI role qualifies for H-1B classification.

items.title: Australia tightens training visa rules with offshore application requirement
items.summary: Australia has tightened rules for training visas, making it mandatory for applicants to apply from outside Australia. The new requirement means applicants can no longer apply for training visas while already in the country.

items.title: Australia student visa rejections rise, Indian applicants affected
items.summary: Student visa rejections in Australia have increased significantly, with Indian applicants particularly impacted by the surge. The higher refusal rate represents a notable shift in Australia's student visa approval patterns for Indian nationals.

items.title: Permanent residence: 5 critical Canada checks for 2027
items.summary: Five important criteria will be critical for Canada permanent residence applications in 2027. Applicants should be aware of these key checks that will determine their eligibility for Canadian PR.

items.title: New proposed Australian visa rules could affect international applicants
items.summary: Australia is reportedly considering new visa rules that may impact international applicants. The proposed changes could affect how people from various countries, potentially including India, apply for Australian visas in the future.

items.title: Canada Express Entry changes: High-wage workers to get up to 100 additional CRS points
items.summary: Canada's Express Entry system is awarding up to 100 additional Comprehensive Ranking System points to high-wage workers. This change significantly boosts the scores of applicants in higher salary brackets.

items.title: Australia Cracks Down On Student Visa Switches
items.summary: Australia has introduced tighter controls on students switching between visa categories. The crackdown aims to restrict the ability of international students to change their visa status while in the country.

items.title: Democrats won Congress. Why Indians on H-1Bs shouldn't celebrate yet
items.summary: Despite Democrats winning Congress, Indian workers holding H-1B visas are advised to remain cautious. The article suggests that the political shift may not immediately translate into favourable immigration policy changes for H-1B holders.

items.title: Australia's New Biometric Rules for Indian Visa Applicants: Who Needs to Comply?
items.summary: Australia has introduced new biometric requirements for Indian visa applicants. The High Commission has clarified which categories of applicants must comply with the updated biometric collection rules.

items.title: Canada launches free CRS calculator for new high-wage points
items.summary: Canada has released a free online calculator to help Express Entry candidates assess their Comprehensive Ranking System scores. The tool allows applicants to check how the new high-wage points system affects their ranking.

items.title: Express Entry CRS Changes 2026: IRCC Pauses Draws for Up to Two Weeks
items.summary: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada has temporarily paused Express Entry draws for up to two weeks following changes to the Comprehensive Ranking System. The pause is linked to the implementation of new CRS scoring rules.

items.title: Can Democrats reverse Trump's H-1B policies after US midterms?
items.summary: India Today examines whether the Democratic party can reverse H-1B visa policies following the US midterm elections and what the results mean for immigrants. The report discusses potential implications for Indian workers in America.

items.title: Will Democrats fix the H-1B slot crisis after midterm win?
items.summary: Following the US midterm elections, this report examines whether the Democratic party will address the shortage of H-1B visa slots, a critical issue affecting Indian professionals seeking to work in the United States.

items.title: Indians can now explore Austria on a 12-month working holiday visa
items.summary: Austria is now offering a working holiday visa to Indian citizens, allowing them to stay and work in the country for up to twelve months. This opens a new opportunity for young Indians to experience living and working in Austria.

items.title: Australia 407 Visa Rules Change November 12, 2026
items.summary: Australia is implementing changes to the 407 visa category, which is used for training purposes. The new rules will take effect from November 12, 2026. Applicants should be aware of these upcoming modifications to the visa requirements.

items.title: Can Democrats reverse Trump's H-1B policies? What US midterms mean for immigrants
items.summary: The US midterm election results may have implications for H-1B visa policies and immigration rules affecting Indian workers. The article examines whether Democrats could potentially reverse previous H-1B restrictions and what the political changes mean for immigrants.

items.title: 2027-2029 Immigration Levels Plan: 380,000 PR Target Held
items.summary: Canada has maintained its permanent residence target at three hundred and eighty thousand for the 2027 to 2029 immigration levels plan. The target remains unchanged from previous planning periods.

items.title: UAE Golden Visa: Graduates from top 100 universities can qualify for 10-year residency
items.summary: The UAE Golden Visa programme now allows international graduates from the world's top one hundred universities to qualify for ten-year residency. This provides a long-term residency pathway for highly qualified graduates seeking to live and work in the UAE.

items.title: Canada Publishes Official Cost of 10-Year Super Visa for Applicants
items.summary: Canada has officially announced the fee structure for the ten-year Super Visa, which allows parents and grandparents of Canadian citizens and permanent residents to visit for extended periods. Applicants can now review the published costs for this visa category.

items.title: US midterm results bring hope for Indian students, but visa worries remain
items.summary: The recent US midterm election results may offer some optimism for Indian students, though concerns about visa policies and processes continue. The political changes could potentially influence student visa regulations and the overall environment for international students from India.

items.title: Will Democratic control of Congress bring relief to Indian H-1B holders?
items.summary: Following the US midterm elections, questions arise about whether Democratic control of Congress could lead to changes benefiting Indian H-1B visa holders. The article examines potential policy shifts that may affect Indian professionals working in America.

items.title: India-EU trade deal to ease mobility for Indian professionals
items.summary: A reported India-EU trade agreement is expected to make it easier for Indian professionals to move for work, though work visas will still be required. The deal aims to facilitate professional mobility while maintaining existing visa requirements for employment.

items.title: Australia reviews tough student visa rules as universities face revenue loss
items.summary: Australia is reportedly reviewing its stricter student visa regulations after universities experienced financial losses. The review suggests possible changes to current visa policies that have affected international student enrolments and institutional income.

items.title: Australia introduces new biometric requirements for Indian student visa applicants
items.summary: Australia has introduced new biometric requirements for Indian students applying for visas in 2026. The change affects student visa applicants from India who will now need to provide biometric data as part of their application process.

items.title: Australia expands biometric requirements for visa applicants in India
items.summary: Australia has expanded biometric requirements for visa applicants in India. The new measures affect those applying for Australian visas from India, requiring additional biometric data collection as part of the application process.

items.title: Australia may require Indian students to deposit funds in local banks
items.summary: Australia's student visa rules could change to require Indian applicants to deposit funds in local Australian banks. The potential new requirement would affect how Indian students demonstrate financial capacity for their visa applications, though the change is not yet confirmed.

items.title: UK raises student visa financial requirement from November 30
items.summary: The UK is increasing the financial requirement for student visa applicants from November 30. Indian students planning to study in the UK will need to demonstrate higher funds to meet the new threshold for visa approval.

items.title: Could the SMARTER Act change how Indians get US Green Cards?
items.summary: The SMARTER Act, being discussed around the US midterm elections, could potentially change the green card process for Indians. The proposed legislation may affect how Indian applicants navigate the permanent residency pathway in the United States.

items.title: Number of active Indian students in US falls by 13.5% amid visa issues
items.summary: The number of active Indian students in the United States has dropped by 13.5 per cent, with visa issues cited as a contributing factor. The decline reflects challenges Indian students are facing in obtaining and maintaining US student visas.

items.title: Indian students reconsidering Canada due to job uncertainty and safety concerns
items.summary: Indian students are rethinking their education plans for Canada, citing job uncertainty and safety concerns. The shift in sentiment is affecting Canada's appeal as a study destination among Indian applicants.

items.title: Australia expands biometric requirements for visa applicants in India
items.summary: Australia has expanded biometric requirements for visa applicants applying from India. Students and other visa applicants will need to comply with new rules regarding biometric data submission. The changes affect those applying for Australian visas from India.

items.title: Number of active Indian students in US falls by 13.5% amid visa issues
items.summary: The number of active Indian students in the United States has declined by 13.5 percent. Visa issues are cited as a contributing factor to this significant drop in Indian student enrollment at US educational institutions.

items.title: Indian students cite visa issues, job prospects and safety for avoiding Canada
items.summary: Indian students are avoiding Canada due to visa issues, poor job prospects and safety concerns. The combination of these factors is making Canada a less attractive study destination for students from India compared to previous years.

items.title: New Zealand announces estimated selection dates for Parent Resident Visa queue
items.summary: New Zealand has provided estimated selection dates for Parent Resident Visa applicants waiting under the queue system. This update gives applicants an indication of when their applications may be processed under the current queue arrangement.

items.title: Dubai introduces new online service to simplify tourist visa process
items.summary: Dubai has launched a new online service making tourist visas easier to obtain for travellers. The updated system aims to streamline the application process for visitors planning trips to Dubai.

items.title: US green card applications face new tax scrutiny over unpaid dues
items.summary: US green card applications are now facing increased tax scrutiny, with unpaid tax dues potentially affecting approval decisions and future citizenship applications. Immigration lawyers warn that tax compliance has become a critical factor in the green card assessment process.

items.title: UK Budget introduces visa changes requiring 4 critical checks
items.summary: The UK Budget has introduced visa changes that require applicants to complete four critical checks. These new requirements affect various visa categories and applicants need to be aware of the additional verification steps in the application process.

items.title: UK student visa rules to change: Indians must show up to Rs 18 lakh for living expenses
items.summary: The UK is changing student visa rules, requiring Indian applicants to demonstrate financial capacity of up to Rs 18 lakh to cover living expenses. This represents a change in the financial requirements for Indian students planning to study in the United Kingdom.

items.title: Canada's new express entry rules could put Indian applicants at a disadvantage
items.summary: Canada's new express entry rules may reportedly disadvantage Indian applicants in the immigration process. The changes to the express entry system could affect how Indian candidates are assessed or selected for permanent residence through this pathway.

items.title: US green card lottery 2027: Court blocks reopening of diversity visa programme
items.summary: A court has blocked the reopening of the US Diversity Visa programme for 2027. This affects applicants who were hoping to participate in the green card lottery, which provides a pathway to US permanent residence through a random selection process.
